Communication | Technical Procedure
Introduction
The neax12sa 
 electronic systems is a fully stored program controlled which can send and 
 receive both voice and date singles. It can be handeled as 96 telephone lines 
 up to 384 lines maximum.
The first draft is 
initiated and tested by eng. Abdel-Aleem Ahmed, accepted by eng. Sleem Ahmed 
Ali general director, approved 
by eng. Abd El Kerim Abu Zeid Ismail Head Sector of High Dam Hydraulic Power 
Station, and certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakem: HPGC quality control general director, and MPIS Coordinator.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued, qualified maintenance 
 staff carry the suitable safety ID category,
A work permit must be issued, qualified maintenance 
 staff carry the suitable safety ID category,

79.

Work to be Carried Out
Turn off the 
 power through each case feeding off individually Then tern off the main power.
Plug out the 
 cards respectively and clean the cards and contact points.
Clean the mother 
 board by using of air blower and clean the board contact points with the cards 
 by dry cleaning spray.
Turn on the 
 power and measure the following volts ( 5 , 12 , - 58 , - 48 ).
Turn off the 
 power again.
Plug in the 
 cards respectively as before and in stole the systems cover.
Turn on the 
 power and test the sys- through the program review.
